chc.transitNote: Station night: a short taxi from Addington station (about 3 km) to a central hotel is fine. Rental car: no desk at the station is confirmed. So collect the car the morning after arriving, and drop it off by 5pm the day before the 07:00 train north. The motels near the station are kept as walkable alternatives.
